findings.finding: A1 covers the selected ozone/UV-B and acute exposure pathways and is scientifically correct. It does not enumerate CFC-12 greenhouse impact, which S1 also documents. Neither text nor rubric claims an exhaustive inventory or says CFC-12 lacks climate impact.
findings.requiredAction: No blocking change. When assessing an actual answer, accept a correctly sourced additional CFC-12 climate argument and do not interpret A/B as ozone-only versus climate-only substance categories.

findings.finding: The brief anticipates professional recovery; the full task and teacher guidance also permit a reasoned professionally managed closed-preservation option. The whole package leaves the concrete recommendation variable, as appropriate without condition/leak data.
findings.requiredAction: No scientific HOLD. Use R6 and the complete case: judge reasoning and release prevention, and do not require unconditional recovery as the sole correct verdict.

wholeGoalOperatorCoverage.operator: research use in everyday life and technology
wholeGoalOperatorCoverage.rationale: Vehicle and technical cooling are concrete daily-life/technical uses. Each case requires a separate actual search/read contribution; supplied dossiers cannot satisfy R1 alone.

wholeGoalOperatorCoverage.operator: weigh human and environmental consequences of release
wholeGoalOperatorCoverage.rationale: A separates atmospheric chlorine/ozone/UV-B consequences from acute local exposure; B separates no chlorine-mediated ozone depletion, greenhouse impact and local exposure. Benefit, options, uncertainties and a bounded recommendation are required.
Publisher/author, visible date, purpose/interests, precise claim and limits must be evaluated. Fictional marketing is clearly identified and cannot serve as independent scientific evidence.
A very short genuine quote with a locator and actual accessible source must be supplied in each case; source text, paraphrase, inference and invented advertising remain distinct.

wholeGoalOperatorCoverage.operator: two independent demonstrations and fresh transfer
wholeGoalOperatorCoverage.rationale: A and B have distinct substances and mechanisms and independent research contributions. A changes location and challenges nonflammability as a safety shortcut; B asks about an unidentified chlorine-free alternative and forbids copying HFC-134a properties onto it. Independence must still be evidenced by actual learner work.

caseDecisions.rationale: Complete museum scenario, actual A1 dossier, explicitly invented A2 advert, blank A3 source log, DE/EN task, teacher reasoning and fresh variation are present. Identity/use and bounded atmospheric versus direct exposure consequences are supported by S1-S3. The task requires real research, an authentic source quote, critical comparison and two plausible preservation/release-prevention options; missing amounts and condition data correctly limit the conclusion. No real handling or German law is asserted.

Complete existing HFC-134a system scenario, actual B1 fact sheet, fictional B2 advert, blank independent B3 log, DE/EN task, teacher reasoning and new-substance transfer are present. S1/S4 support identity, ozone/climate distinction and conditional local hazards. A second real search/quote is required. Rejecting ozone-friendly therefore environmentally neutral needs substance-specific reasoning, and a replacement lifecycle winner cannot be asserted without energy/leakage/lifetime data.
